clayresearch.delta: Adaptive visual learning should enter the integrated architecture first as ordinary typed/versioned Clay state with explicit uncertainty, provenance, replay and rollback. Do not create a new language primitive unless normative execution produces a counterexample.

frank.delta: A local deterministic state-machine proxy represents the owner-fixed MVC trust/open-set/budget/promotion/rollback laws with existing ClayCode-like typed state. This supports representability only; it is not live FRANK or H1/H2 evidence.

gwt.delta: MVC familiarity output remains a routing/readout input. UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS/CONFLICT must remain explicit escalation states; KNOWN_HIGH_CONFIDENCE may alter visual compute only with preserved sensor provenance. GWT causal-use/outcome/re-entry receipts remain required for system-level benefit claims.

emergenz.delta: Deterministic/replayable learner state and cross-module routing do not establish emergence. No emergence claim changed.

claycode.delta: H-SPAWN-MVC-001: current G9 generic records/types/rules/epochs appear sufficient at semantic-proxy level for MVC state; next discriminator is normative parser -> canonical typed IR -> type/effect -> evaluator/lowering execution. No semantic promotion.

hyperposition.delta: The run preserves explicit alternative epistemic outcomes but did not test a new higher-order topology or contextual-hyperposition mechanism.

claygraph.delta: Learned familiarity/prototype relations must carry learner-version and evidence ancestry and may influence activation/routing, but they cannot upgrade sensor evidence or canonical truth. Backbone-version invalidation must invalidate dependent learned relations or mark migration explicitly.

unifieddb.delta: Required replay/persistence surface includes current/candidate/LKG classifier identity, feature-backbone compatibility, calibration identity, GOLD/SILVER/BRONZE example lineage, resource-budget state, evaluation receipts, atomic promotion history and rollback/rebuild links.

harness.delta: Use the committed semantic proxy as a future H1/H2 differential oracle family: identical event traces must preserve BRONZE non-admission, stale-backbone rejection, open-set escalation, budget pause without perception failure, atomic promotion/LKG and rollback. Add crash/restart and concurrent candidate-update cases before H1/H2 PASS.

shared_ancestry_warning: Frank/ClayCode/Harness agreement over owner-fixed MVC requirements is shared ancestry and not independent replication.
